_note: Stage B wave 3: the market legs of 6 topics, one backtest.py run per leg. Same layout as wave2.json: _source says what the legs mirror, _outputs maps a leg to the file under <topic>/results/ its ltp run is installed as, and exchange_comparison.json is rebuilt after that. _checks is the --check list that applies to the topic: run the gate once per check set, with --topic. pairs = the stage A gate pairs (load_legs needs one even where stage-a does not run). See scripts/LTP_GATE.md.

52-week-high._source: backtest.py --global presets_to_run, one run per market (taiwan is TAI and canada TSX there, as in the live files). us is --preset us: the same book as --global's NYSE,NASDAQ,AMEX, labelled US_MAJOR as the live file is. norway stays benchmark-truncated (^OSEAX starts 2013); it is the whole-topic ltp rerun's leg, not a wave3_osl.json repair
52-week-high._checks: stage-a,det,flip: 5 runs a leg (both, drop, ltp, default, ltp.rep)

dcf-discount._source: EXCHANGE_PRESETS legs (--preset), one per region file generate_charts.py REGIONS reads: canada is TSX+TSXV and taiwan TAI+TWO, as in the live files. Not the --global list: it runs canada as TSX alone and singapore as SGX (no rows), and writes returns_<KEY>.json, which the charts read only when no region file exists. australia and brazil are legs because REGIONS reads their files; their posts are retraction pages and the comparison chart leaves both out
dcf-discount._checks: stage-a,det,flip: 5 runs a leg (both, drop, ltp, default, ltp.rep)

defensive-quality._source: backtest.py --global presets_to_run, plus two legs it does not run and the comparison post cites: china_shh (SHH alone, the post's China row; the charts' China is SHZ_SHH) and southafrica (JNB, cited as all cash). us is --exchange, so universe equals the comparison key; the live file was a --preset us run of the same exchanges. india is NSE: the live comparison key BSE_NSE has no leg
defensive-quality._checks: stage-a,det,flip: 5 runs a leg (both, drop, ltp, default, ltp.rep)

pairs-fundamentals._source: backtest.py --global presets_to_run, as --exchange so universe equals the file key. canada is TSX alone, as --global runs it: the live returns_TSX.json was the preset (TSX+TSXV). india is NSE: returns_BSE_NSE.json has no leg. switzerland, thailand and singapore are run because the posts name them as excluded
pairs-fundamentals._checks: stage-a,det,flip: 5 runs a leg (both, drop, ltp, default, ltp.rep). Its own invocation: --topic pairs-fundamentals

pairs-zscore._source: backtest.py --global presets_to_run, as --exchange so universe equals the file key. canada is TSX alone, as --global runs it: the live returns_TSX.json was the preset (TSX+TSXV). india is NSE: returns_BSE_NSE.json has no leg
pairs-zscore._checks: det,flip only: 3 runs a leg (ltp, default, ltp.rep). The topic accepts only --exit-method ltp (a pair closes at its last common bar; there is no drop book), so stage-a's both and drop runs exit 2 at the parser. Run with --topic pairs-zscore,pairs-multi-pair

pairs-multi-pair._source: backtest.py --global presets_to_run, as --exchange so universe equals the file key. canada is TSX alone, as --global runs it: the live returns_TSX.json was the preset (TSX+TSXV). india is NSE: returns_BSE_NSE.json has no leg. Every run also writes diversification_<its output file name> beside its output: the us leg's diversification_us.ltp.json is installed as results/diversification_analysis.json
pairs-multi-pair._checks: det,flip only: 3 runs a leg (ltp, default, ltp.rep). The topic accepts only --exit-method ltp (a pair closes at its last common bar; there is no drop book), so stage-a's both and drop runs exit 2 at the parser. Run with --topic pairs-zscore,pairs-multi-pair
